reviews.text: Best habit tracker app. This is the best habit tracking app I’ve ever used. It perfectly manages the balance of robust features without needless over complication. I love how visual and aesthetic the whole app is and how flexible it is. Highly recommend!!

Simplicity. I've tried several habit tracking apps but this was the one I decided to purchase and use for almost 6 months atp. It's by far the most simplistic of the apps in its category, but that's what's drawn me to it and kept me in it. If I do the thing, it's easy to open the app and quickly mark it. If I need to do it multiple times a day, I set it up in the advanced options. I don't care much about the analytics of my habits but I really appreciate the different week, month, ytd viewing options. I think some improvements could be made with managing categories/labels, but anything else would generally take away from the minimalism of habitkit that i so deeply appreciate. It's been such a help for my mental health. Thank you!
Need Apple watch widgets. Please add option to check things off from apple watch.
Dissatisfied. This app sucks
Nice app. Nice app. Really needs iCloud syncing across devices 🙏
Amazing app. I’ve tried tons of habit trackers. This was the one for me, been using it for a year and going strong. Fantastic long term tracking visually
Good. Very helpful application

Absolutely Love!. I love this app for tracking my habits! I’ve tried other apps and none of them were as good as this one. I like that I can choose a dark background and because of all the bright colors, it looks beautiful. I have the PRO version and o definitely think it’s worth the money, and it’s not expensive at all. I can track as many habits as I want to, and I can archive them when I want to stop tracking them (but it doesn’t delete them so I can “unarchive”them if I want to start tracking that habit again. I would like to suggest a couple of things that I think could make it better…first, I’d love to be able to set an alarm for my habits to remind me to do some of them. I’d also like to have a bigger color selection to choose from. The colors it has are beautiful and vibrant but I’d just like to add some more shades (because I track a lot of habits). I love the icons too, and the fact that I can reorder my habits at any time. All in all, it’s a fantastic app and I use it everyday! I’d definitely recommend for EVERYONE to get the pro version, and start tracking your habits! I’ve gotten a lot more consistent since I started using this app!
Simply Perfect. It’s the type of simple I want. It’s something I did do on paper but I wanted digitally.
Review. Great app. Like one of those life changing apps. But I accidentally deleted it once, and lost all my data. Wish it was stored in the cloud.

There’s beauty in simplicity.. Super well thought out app. Incredibly easy to setup and manage. And it’s beautifully rendered too. I just love the colorfully graphical way it represents my habitual consistency. ❤️this app.
Needs sync. Seems good, but with no cloud sync, it’s not very useful to me.

Pretty good. I wish it had the ability to toggle which habits have a longer-term view individually. Some habits don’t need to be done every day, and those I’d prefer a longer-term view (like monthly) but I’d get confused if I was looking at my daily habits through a monthly view.
,). в статистике за год процент выполнения считается с начала привычки. а хотелось бы чтобы весь год считался

Great for tracking my art projects!. I was looking for a way to track the number of days I spend on a project and a way to keep me motivated to work on them to completion. HabitKit Pro has been perfect for this! I started tracking as a New Year’s resolution and now it’s a regular part of my creative routine. Additionally, Sebastian responded quickly to my email about a few new ideas for his product. I appreciate the app developer’s response and look forward to what he comes up with next!
Great Habit Tracking App. Fantastic habit tracking app with a great aesthetic that the dev is actively working on and continuing to update and improve!
Simple and great. I really like the simplicity of the setup and use interface.

satisfying and streamlined habit tracker. An app that does just what you want it to do without adding AI bloatware or unnecessary UI. Really nice widgets as well that let you update habits directly from the home screen. :)

Very Nice. Bro, I bought the app it’s absolutely awesome! Minimalist, focused, secure everything’s spot on, all data stays on the phone. Please, don’t clutter it with pointless features and distracting buttons. Right now, it’s perfectly balanced and visually pleasing. It’s a finished product. 
And for those who want “more of everything” just make them a separate version 😄

best I've tried, but no sync across devices. Intuitive and good customization. All of my goals are x number of times per week -- not daily nor tied to a specific day of the week. The numeric streak count for weekly goals is strange, so I don't use it. But at least the graphical boxes can show me if I'm where I want to be or not. But I really wish that the app would sync across devices!! That is the one feature that I'm sorely missing.

Great app, responsive developer. I went through a bunch of habit tracking apps before finally landing on HabitKit. It’s simple to use, not too many features or too restrictive features. Just the right amount of control to help me track my habits. The developer is also very responsive to feedback, which I appreciate!
The best out there.. If you need a reason to track your habits this one has the most beneficial information and ease of use out there. The pro purchase is so worth it to support this dev and app!
Great app. The ui is very clean and it’s satisfying to watch the calendars fill up!
Subscription. Must pay to track more than 4
Perfect. No frills, straightforward, simple app. Love it

Best one out there !. I looked at many, even tried others but HABITKIT was best, easiest and pretty to look at and track. Also fast response from the developer if any questions !! Loved it enough to buy the paid version and get unlimited tracking. Save yourself time - just get this one - I know you’ll love it too.
Excellent. great way to visually see progress and keep track of streaks, very easy and satisfying to use

Best tracker out there. Hands down one of the best habit trackers that I’ve found out there. The user interface is very intuitive and easy to use. It has absolutely everything I was looking for.
1. Ability to set daily, weekly or monthly goals.
2. Ability to create a goal that requires multiple completions to count toward a streak (i.e. taking meds you can create two instances that go toward one goal).
3. Reminders that you can create to help you remember to complete your goal. Let’s face it some of us get busy and lose track of things we want to do during the day and this helps immensely.

These functions are in the pro version which is completely worth it, without a doubt.
Exactly what I was looking for. This app is really well done, intuitive, feature rich, and has a beautiful interface. Really appreciate the widget support, and analytics views to help recap
Perfect. Everything you need, nothing you don’t.

Almost perfect - Few updates needed. I first downloaded HabitKit in the ending of March 2025. I bought the lifetime premium version. When I first downloaded the app, it didn't have an option for putting your own emojis for habits, which was really frustrating. I'm very happy that they finally put an emoji update. I was tired of using a dog bone for my seafood habit. My issue with the new update is that you can't change the skin color of the emojis. It's also disappointing that you can't choose a set of Crayola like colors for your habits including brown, instead of the preset pastel colors that is given. No true red or solid purples just a pastel palette for everything... I also think that the counter for 1, 5, 10 , 15 shouldn't be there. I think that instead the only option should be to set your own number of "Pages read" for each habit. It would look much better for the eyes that way. Or at least give the option to turn it off and only have your own preset number. I also think that the HabitKit wrapped should be worded better and upgraded. Besides those things, this is a decent app for habit tracking. I do also believe having a bad habit tracker section or page would be great, and helpful for separation of good and bad habits. Plus not being able to sync to iCloud is hella wack. I can only give 2 stars because I know it could be better.

The Perfect App For What I Needed. This app on my phone has been insanely helpful and so easy to use. I can track anything going on in my life and then easily look back over the history of my habit. Things like how frequently I’m vacuuming or if I took my medication each day or week. Every time I login and track my habits it also reminds me of things I might not have done yet like…oh I haven’t done that thing yet today. So I often get up to start or finish something because I see that it isn’t checked off for the day. 

What makes this app better than others I was looking at is that I’m 100% choosing my own categories and specific tasks. So my weird and wonderful lists are tailored perfectly to me, and there isn’t anything extraneous. 

The only complaint I have is that the data is only on your device. So I can see and use it on my phone but I can’t pull it up on my tablet or computer. I reached out to the developers and they say they hope to change this in the future. So fingers crossed, this app could get even better.

Fantastic. Clean UI, no ads, and solid functionality that really motivates you to keep up on your goals! Best of all is a one-time payment alternative to the pro features instead of a forced subscription. Love it!

really good. the ui is awesome and minimal but not too boring to where it feels half-baked. unlimited habits and completely free and i really hopes it stays like that, i get exhausted when a subscription is constantly being pushed in my face. one thing i would like it so be able and check older days since i do have busy nights and early mornings, but its a great app for those who love this design and layout

Best habit app you will find!. I’ve genuinely tried all the habit apps- simple ones, complex ones, gamified ones, expensive ones and HabitKit is easily the best of the bunch.

The grid based visual tracking is brilliant. It’s simple, motivating, and incredibly satisfying to look at. No unnecessary fluff, no overwhelming features- just a beautifully designed system that actually makes you want to stay consistent.

Customization is excellent, the UI is clean and intuitive, and it strikes the perfect balance between powerful and easy to use. This is the first habit app I’ve stuck with long term.

If you’re serious about building habits (or breaking bad ones), stop searching. HabitKit is it.

Does one thing and does it well!. Interface is clean and responsive, the app doesn’t feel sluggish at all. Records your data smoothly and then shows it to you how you want it, exactly how a habit tracker should. Developer is active and responsive to feedback. Pro subscription offers a lifetime option which is greatly appreciated in a sea of apps and services where you keep paying up every month for no additional value and could lose features if you don’t go up a tier at any time.
Really Impressed. The best habit tracker I've found. Beautiful, fluid, and doesn’t get in the way. The developer is responsive and helpful. Really impressed.

Simple, reliable and beautifully designed. Been using HabitKit daily for 2 years now and it’s become my go-to habit tracker. Clean interface, no bloat, just works. The widget support is excellent for quick check-ins.

One small wish: a basic read-only API would open up automation possibilities for power users, but that’s a nice-to-have.

Highly recommended for anyone serious about building habits.

Love this App. It is clean, simple, and actually makes habit tracking enjoyable. No clutter nor overcomplication. I use it daily and it’s easily one of my favorites.

Highly recommend

Good. It’s a good app! I have the pro version and as much as I enjoy it, I do not feel that the pro version should cost as much as it does. The app does not have enough features to justify the $13 pro. $5 or $10 would be more acceptable. Also, there is a fixed amount of colors that you can make your habits that you’re tracking, and of the 21 available colors, 4 of them are just different shades of grey. I really wish there was access to a color wheel or something so you can select more colors. The blues and greens that are available are way too similar. I, and I’m sure many others, need a lot of visual variety when tracking habits like this. And when you’re tracking over 10 habits, it gets difficult to visually distinguish between 4 shades of grey and 6 shades of mildly different blueish green

Great habit tracker! Worth the price. I spontaneously bought the lifetime access because I want to start tracking certain daily and weekly things I wanted to do or not do. I have been using for 2 months now every day. It’s great! 

It’s customizable, yet not confusing. As a UX/UI designer myself, I appreciate the balance of simplicity and flexibility. 

Only improvements I’d love to see are the ability to have an anti-streak calculator for habits I’m trying to break, and some more robust reporting in terms of trends.

Overall a great, daily app! Get it!

Best hair tracker app. Awesome app, better than Atoms and all the other habit trackers. The price to unlock all features ($2/month, $12/year) is reasonable and affordable. I upgraded to the yearly subscription after trying it out for a week. This is fun to use which means I’ll keep using it. I like that you can add a corresponding emoji to each habit and include a habit description. I also like that you can set streak goals in multiple ways. This app just has all the best features. I’m thankful it exists.

Love this app. I’ve tried a number of habit tracking apps, but this one just works for me. It’s been fun and flexible to customize, and I find myself checking it daily. Better yet I added my habits as a stacked widget on one of my iPhone home screens and it’s been satisfying to swipe through and check off set habits each day. I had a small feature request, sent feedback to the developer and same day, he mentioned this feature was already on the roadmap. Was impressed with the response time. Glad to support this independent developer and his great app which has improved my life!

Habit tracker. I am really enjoying this app. It is simple to use and reasonably priced. I reached out to the developer with a possible recommendation and he emailed me back immediately. Highly recommend!

No bad habit tracking and No Apple Watch support.. I’m dissatisfied with the app. I purchased only to find out that it does not include bad habit tracking, only requires you to use work around. The app also does not have an Apple Watch app. Please integrate these and I will update my review.

Great but lacks cloud syncing. Really great app but lacks cloud syncing which seems crazy for an app entering 2026 and is the main reason I am hesitant to pay for the premium subscription. I also don’t understand how the app counts streaks for “x times per week” habits. I’m on a 12 week streak for a habit I started 8 weeks ago.

Simple is Beautiful. This app checks a few boxes for me:
It allows me to see the trends of my habits over time, allowing me to see what i need to improve or fix. 
I can easily keep track of habits in multiple areas of my life, from working out, studying, and down to simple things like remembering to water my plants. 

While I can use notes, or a to-do list, or alarms, HabitKit allows you to come to one place for all of that-in a more fun and satisfying place. 

Honestly, the colors, icons, calendar, and organization through putting habits in certain categories keeps everything neat and aesthetically pleasingly. Everyone has their way of doing what this app does, but the way habit kit does it is what allows me to use it this thoroughly. Actually, it makes keeping in touch with my goals and to-dos fun-something lacking from other apps whether pre-installed, or otherwise. 

Being able to see your goals and habits stack up or lack over time is the big indicator on how well/poor Im doing, and thats the motivator for however you choose to track your trends. 

Long time user of the app, and I’ll keep on using it to perfect my routine. Well done Habitkit, looking forward to future updates that reflect the simple brilliance you have here already.

Could be SO MUCH BETTER. I know the app isn't abandoned, but it feels abandoned. No cloud sync or cloudkit. No Mac app. No bad habit mode that automatically checks off days. No custom icon support (icon library very limited). No custom colors. It just feels abandoned. With a couple weekends of work the developer could be making double what they are making now with a few tweaks. C'mon!
Great, simple, intuitive, bug-free as far as I can tell. Nice app.. Great, simple, intuitive, bug-free as far as I can tell. Nice app.

A Game Changer. I recently turned started using a minimalist phone setup to help me to be more productive. A key part of the design was adding HabitKit widgets to my home screen. It's very motivating to see your habit history packed into a beautiful little chart, with the ability to check off (or increment) habits without having to open the app. After making these changes to my phone, this past week has been the most productive week of my life, and I sincerely believe HabitKit has been the main reason for that. 

The support is also incredible. I reached out to the solo developer via email, asking him about 2 different features I was hoping he could add to the app. 2 days later, he got back to me, in a very friendly and well-thought-out email. In this email, he told me that he had already been working on adding the first feature, and the other had been added to his todo list. Given that he is a solo developer, and also working on another up-and-coming app at the same time, I'd say his support services are the best I've ever seen, from any app on the app store.

Great app, some suggestions. Seriously loving this app so far - it’s pretty much exactly what I was looking for. Thank you for offering a one-time purchase option - it’s rare these days and you’re awesome for that

Two suggestions:

> negative habits
- basically the opposite of a regular habit, allowing you to set a limit for how many times a day, if any before the color turns off
- this could even be as simple as a habit that auto-completes at the start of the day, but you can go back and manually uncheck it

> web app
- it’s a big ask, but even just like a dashboard accessible on the web would be fantastic

keep up the good work
Widget not unlocking. I bought the lifetime subscription, but the widget is not unlocking. Great app but would like this feature to be fixed. Thank you!
Worth every penny. Awesome App and I can’t wait till we have iCloud compatibility
Everything you need. This is a wonderfully designed app. Simple, intuitive, adaptable. Everything you need, nothing you don’t.

Best habit tracker out there. HabitKit is by far the best habit tracker I have used… and I have used several. It is sleek and simple, yet customizable. 

The options for viewing my habits are perfect for the ways in which I think about them- in both the short and long term. I can manage my day-to-day easily with a high-level, consolidated view of all my habits, while still being able to see the big picture over an extended period of time with a GitHub-esque chart. 

Bonus points for a responsive developer, and continued improvements. Highly recommend.

Helped me. I wanted to use it so I would read my Bible daily and this was the only app that helped, highly recommend. 
P.S. Keep it free

Very good. I’ve been looking for a good Habit tracking app on iOS. I tested seven and ended up choosing this one. I really like the simplicity, aesthetic, straightforwardness, and overall good usability of this app. Also the pro version is also of the cheapest out there. $2 a month, or $30 lifetime. Compared to $10 a month and $90 lifetime pro versions. I recommend it!

HabitKit + Automations = SUCCESS. HabitKit is hands-down the best habit app I’ve used. It has enabled me to set up old hotel key cards as NFC triggers when I tap one for my morning supplements, it marks the habit complete, reads the weather, starts my playlist, and tells me my calendar for the day. Everything just flows. The design is clean, automations work flawlessly, and the developer is super responsive. Absolutely worth it!

Reliable and Pretty. I’ve been using it for a month and haven’t seen any bugs. I love the visual style more than any other habit app, and it’s the main reason I chose it. HabitKit just feels good to use, and that’s important for an app you use daily.
Nice App but Lacking. I really like this app, it reminds me of GitHub but I wish the widgets allowed me to see more then one habit at a time, or gave me a overview.

Easy, motivating, and ad free. I’ve been using this app for almost two months now to track the days I drink enough water. The layout itself is pretty self explanatory and simple, and the lack of ads makes it very easy to log on and check off a streak without distractions and wasting time. The free version of Habitkit works very well if you have a few habits you want to track, and works perfect despite not being premium. I personally hate when developers force users into buying a subscription for the basic features their app has been made to offer by nagging with constant ads and an overall worse experience with the app, so Habitkit is one of the rare gems among many slop apps who suffer from such issues.

Thank you, developer!
Una aplicación Magnífica. La app se ajusta a lo que uno busca perfectamente, visualmente es muy bonito y moderno, llevo meses usándolo y estoy muy contento, felicitaciones a los creadores
icloud synchronous. Can the icloud synchronous backup function be added?
Love this app. I tried a handful of different habit trackers before landing on this one and I am really enjoying it so far!

Form and Function 🤌🏼. HabitKit has been able to accomplish something that no other habit tracker has: I actually use it. The layout is so useful and logical, with all of the distracting junk stripped away. Its simplicity does not make it any less powerful, however. In fact, I think that is the thing that propels HabitKit ahead of all the others in terms of excellence. It strikes the perfect balance of simple and functional/customizable while also being beautiful. 

Data is powerful, but only if you can actually collect it. Now, I can.
Good app-with paid version. I love seeing the grids as a way to visualize consistency! I have the paid version of the app, can't speak to the limits of the free version. Solid app.
The habit tracker I was looking for. Simple, effective, intuitive. Looks nice. Finally an habit tracker app I love!
Zen Simplicity. This app is fantastic. Super simply and clear to use, it helping me a lot with practicing positive habits. I greatly appreciate the lifetime purchase option.
Very Good Habit Tracker. Very good habit tracker that has robust features as long as you pay for the pro version to unlock widgets.

Intuitive and eloquent. After trying many apps, this is the one that just works. Other apps may work in a technical sense, however, this one sticks to the fundamentals, allowing use without thinking too much.

One of the best habit tracking apps - but NEEDS iOS Reminders integration and maybe APIs exposed ?. This is by far the most visually appealing app. I was actually going to develop my own app which was similar to this, where it had the altair heatmap chart. But this goes beyond my initial idea and also has step counts/tiered counting. Moreover, the ease of completing a task with a tap, setting of reminders, color coding and the availability to switch between three different views is exactly what I needed.

This is way better than todoist, it is simple and intuitive. Most other apps have a lot of clutter and have too many details and clunky interfaces.

One important feature that is missing though is its integration with Calendar and Reminders. Not just that, PLEASE expose APIs to interact with the data, this would have a limited use case, but still could be very useful. For example, one could ingest their daily step count and automatically mark a habit. Another example is that say if I want to block a particular app unless I do X, it could allow it to do so. Lets say that I have a habit like “no scrolling videos in the morning for 2 hours”, I should be able to enforce this and mark the habit only when certain conditions outside the app are met - I know this is a little outside the scope of this app and probably would fit into another “habit enforcer” app that could integrate with this, but in any case this requires REST APIs to be exposed. I would love to partner with the dev and work on this idea.

Just right. This app is the exact thing I needed. It is simple and provides a visualization of goals. I can even quickly show the extent to which I reached a goal per day. Try it! It might be just what you’re looking for.

The best habit tracker I’ve used. I’ve tried a bunch of habit tracker apps, and honestly, they all felt like they were missing something until I came across HabitKit. It’s exactly what I needed. Great functionality, amazing design and actually helps me stay on track without feeling overwhelming. I’ve been using it every day, and it’s really helping me build better habits and move toward the kind of future I want. Super grateful I found this one. And I'm so happy that from today I'm subscribed to the pro version of HabitKit. :)

Simple and effective. I purposefully chose a habit tracker a little down on the App Store because I wanted something simple, it a lot of gadgets. This is it. Basic, won’t waste your time but will help you get your goals done.
Good Product. I enjoy the interface and the functionality.
No notifications. This app doesn't have notifications. So there's no way to get notified when to log a habit. I don't understand how this isn't a feature.

Great design and updates. HabitKit is an awesome app if you like tracking your progress on anything. The UI is excellent and continues to receive quality updates, and the widgets are super convenient. The summary analytics are also a really nice touch. Easily worth the purchase price.
Great app. One of the few apps that I have ever paid for that I didn’t regret.

Very confusing. Way too much going on for something as simple as tracking “habits” the app is eye appealing, but anyone who wants to use it should not go through so much trouble trying to understand it. I still haven’t figured it out and I will be deleting after this review.
Awesome App. A well designed, simple, intuitive, and customizable habit tracking app. Highly recommend.
Productivity Hack. The value for money you get with this app is huge! It has been a growth catalyst for me in prioritizing and creating new habits. Get it - you won’t regret it!

Widgets. Why no widgets? I downloaded this app because I wanted to make a habit for coding and track my progress even on the home screen. My favorite part about apps are the widgets, and I don’t know why you have to pay just to use widgets. I really like this app, but isn’t the no widgets without subscription thing a bit overkill?

Simple, Perfect. This app is exactly what I was looking for: a way to visually understand my habits over time where I'm doing well, where I need to pick it up. It's extremely simple and simple to use. Not only that but the developer is extremely responsive. I sent him an email about something that I wanted, and he responded the next day. 5/5. Download this app if you're looking for any type of habit tracker.
Great graphics!. Clearly shows my progress toward my nutrition goal.

Convert. I was skeptical at first on whether this app would be what I was looking for in a habit app. Some try to do too much and some are too watered down. This hits the right chord with me. Great UI. Especially a home view with a month’s worth of performance in one easy glance.

Simple and effective!. This is the perfect app for happily tracking the habits you need to do to stay healthy and happy. No distracting fluff but enough options to customize each habit to make it appealing to remember and to complete. Reminders are great as well. Super happy with it, and even better it helps me hit my goals! So glad this app exists.

Love it, but have suggestions!. I love the set up, if you like the green squares of GitHub, this habit tracker is for you. However, I think it would be amazing if they implemented a folder or categorization feature. I want my career growth habits to be separate from my health and wellness habits.
Great UI, zero integrations. HabitKit is a bit misleading, as you’d think ‘kit’ would imply some possible integrations. I would love to tap an NFC tag and log a habit.

Best way to visualize progress. This app is great for visualizing and tracking your habits in a multitude of different ways. I really like and value the customization aspect as well, and being able to see my growth never fails to boost my mood!
Amazingly Simple but Effective. However, desperately needs an account and sync function because habits do not sync across devices.
Easy to use. This app is very simple and easy to use, but so versatile!

Great, simple, wish it had a note taking section for each habit. Note taking section would help better refine the habit and track triggers that set you off the track. I’d be willing to subscribe to pro for that.
Needs iCloud sync. Great app but desperately needs iCloud syncing.

Great app, needs syncing.. Really great, functional app with beautiful widgets. Does its job in an easy to use, visually pleasing way on my phone. 

Once it gets an iPad app and iCloud syncing, which the dev says is on the roadmap, it’ll be a 5-star app!

The only habit tracker that makes me feel good!. I have tried many habit trackers but this is the only one that doesn't give me so much anxiety and stress when I miss my streaks. A lot of the other ones try to hold you accountable and stick to goals. While I do wanna do that, some days just make it hard and my busy schedule makes it hard to keep up with everything. HabitKit on the other hand lets you actually just keep tabs on your progress. Yes, maybe you missed a day or week, but you can always see your previous progress and remind yourself that you can still make it up and catch up! It's no surprise that other apps are copying this now! Sebastian's also a really responsive and friendly founder! Really happy to get to support this project!
Simple but Effective. I have been using this app for a while and I found it very useful. It’s super intuitive to use and having widgets is great.
Great habit tracker. I really like this habit tracker. Looking forward to updates and new features
Good idea. Should make a Mac app and give unlimited habits for free. Other paywalled stuff is fine but leaves functionality for free users

Easiest tracker ever!. This is the easiest and most intuitive habit tracker I’ve used and I’ve tried so many of them! It also works great with the shortcuts app so you can use an nfc tag or ask Siri to mark a habit for you!
Amazing UI. Love it. Compared to very cluttered competitor apps, the UI’s simplicity and neatness is a breath of fresh air. And it has all the functionality I was looking for

Perfect for smart goals. I use this app to review weekly smart goals. It’s perfect and does the job of tracking and presenting attractive reports quite well. It’s not ideal for project management or to do lists, but does habits better than any other of the 20 apps I auditioned. I got the paid version and feel it’s worth it.

Needs more color options. Nearly perfect…Would gladly pay for pro or lifetime if it meant I could choose custom colors for habits. As I use widgets to help me stay on track, I need an app that will fit with the color scheme of my background. Unfortunately this is not that app.
Amazing app. I’ve tested a lot of tracker and this one offers the best UX and visualization while keeping it simple and intuitive to use.

Simple, Effective, and Visually Elegant. UPDATE (2025-02-05)

Not sure how long I’ve been using HabitKit (just checked and it has been a bit over two years) and I’m still loving it ♥️

It’s simple, has the features I want, and zero bloat. I love that you can enable/disable streaks because I’m no longer doing streaked habits.

I’ve been using it as a widget stack on my Home Screen (small size, all habits in the stack) and it’s just perfect like this!

 =•= 

I’ve been using the “don’t break the chain” method of habit building for about a billion years. I’ve used apps and my own paper trackers. They all work, more or less, but some just feel better than others, and with something simple like habit tracking, feel is 90% of what’s important.

HabitKit has FEEL son!

There’s something about the simplicity of the app and the ease of logging that just feels right. But more than that, the visual display of your streak is the best I’ve come across. It’s RIGHT in your face. There’s no ignoring it… and that’s a very very good thing.
Simply amazing. I feel like other apps overcomplicate routines and habits but this one is pleasant to use.
Pretty good except for the ads. It’s great but there are wayyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy too many ads of premium

Best habit tracker i found. Overall this is the best habit tracker i found and i went thought a lot. It helps so much to visualize your habit consistency which not many other apps have. Almost perfect. I’ve tried a few habit apps, and absolutely love using this one so far. The user experience is extremely intuitive and easy to use, and has (almost) all the features I was looking for. Just as an example, the Shortcuts integration is great for me - I was able to integrate HabitKit into an existing Shortcut I was using for recording a daily journal, and so now recording one will also automatically mark the habit complete for the day too. The widgets are really nice too and improve the overall interaction.

All that said, there are just a few additional features I’d like to see. First, a MacOS version of the app would be great, though I can confirm that it does work to install the iOS version. However, it would really be awesome if it could sync to iCloud both to make this actually usable, as well as to make it easy when you get a new device. There is an export / import feature for this but this would make it a lot. Lee seamless. Finally, it would be nice to have additional Shortcuts support - the ability to look at past completions / streaks, change completion for other dates, export / import from Shortcut, etc.

With that list, why did I still give it 5 stars? Because even as-is it is incredibly useful and I would recommend it to everyone even without these features (though they would be great!)

I have ADHD and this app really helps me stay motivated and manage my executive dysfunction because I have to gamify EVERYTHING just to do simple things. I like how we are able to select different days for when we want to track a habit, but I wish we could select different reminder times for different days as well under the same habit. Say you want to add a yoga habit for each day, but want reminders at 2:00pm on certain days and 3:00pm on other days for those with varying schedules.

 I also think sub-habit/task would be an interesting game changer. Say you’re trying to incorporate an entire morning routine habit, you can just label the habit morning routine, and you can click it to open, add a sub-habit/task, like make bed, brush teeth, do skin care, and once you check off all three of those things, it will complete that habit for the day. I feel like this would help with lessening the amount of habits you have to make when one habit can incorporate many things you want to do!
